question: Select the correct spelling of a word meaning 'based on reason'.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word meaning 'based on reason' is **'Rational.'**
 
• **'Rational'** is an adjective used to describe something that is logical or based on reason and facts. (**तार्किक**)
 
• Incorrect options:
 
 
• **Rashonal:** This is a misspelling of the word.
 
• **Rationel:** Another incorrect spelling of the word.
 
• **Rashanal:** This is also a misspelling.
 
 

Correct sentence: The correct spelling of the word meaning 'based on reason' is **'Rational.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rational** is often used in contrast to **'Irrational,'** which describes something that does not follow logic or reason.
 
• **Example:** 
 
 
• It is rational to save money for future emergencies.
 
• Her decision to take the job offer was based on rational analysis of its benefits.
